apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- Catalog: a cache entry stamped one second ahead of time() is fresh
- SDL frontend: pausing a game launched from the command line no longer quits
- GS/Vulkan: the pipeline builder checks each vertex array against its own limit
- tests: a Vulkan pipeline with eight vertex attributes takes a second buffer and a ninth attribute
- eerunner: --frame-hashes reads VU1 memory once the VU1 thread is idle
- GS/HW: below 1x, give every render target an exact scaled size
- Android: launch extras that turn PINE on and pick the GPU driver
- gsctl: pad commands and a TCP connection
- eerunner: --pad-script, --pad-record, --frame-hashes and the nullhw renderer
- PINE: messages to hold pads, play pad scripts and record pad input
- Pad: scripts, clients and recordings can hold a DualShock 2
- GS/Vulkan: declare the run shader's depth write depth_less too
- GS/Vulkan: declare the pixel shader's depth write depth_less again
- GS/Vulkan: flush the run machine's index and table rings before the submit
- Android: tell apart malisx2 installed but not selected from malisx2 missing
- gsrunner: drop -readback-kick-passes
- Android: a changed PGO profile rebuilds every object
- SIF: a forced stop of SIF0 or SIF1 ends the EE side of the transfer
- GS/Vulkan: do not spin the GPU for readbacks on Mali
- Qt: give the GS a pending window type while surfaceless
- GS/Vulkan: one sampling call per run on Turnip
- GS/Vulkan: round an unblended draw's output in a blending run
- GS/Vulkan: no run way for Af through the blend constant
- GS/Vulkan: merge the blend unit's own alpha blend into runs
- Android: regenerate the PGO profile on the source with the sprite ramp, alpha rectangle, IOP thread lag and folder memory card changes
- FolderMcd: read a save file the host will not open for writing
- tests: a pause flush during a folder card block rewrite keeps the files
- FolderMcd: rebuild the cluster-to-file map on every flush
- FolderMcd: skip a flush when nothing was written since the last one
- FolderMcd: keep a cached page that the flush could not write
- Android: call the Java file helpers through cached method IDs
- IOP thread: hold the tight lag bound while a memory card server call runs
- GS/Vulkan: decide full-screen exclusive from the window system on Windows
- GS/Metal: shrink the pipeline selector's padding for the two-byte VSSelector
- GS/Vulkan: accept VK_KHR_calibrated_timestamps as well as the EXT name
- GS/Vulkan: give a device window support while its Android surface is gone
- GS/Vulkan: signal the spin semaphore only when the spin has its own queue
- GS/Vulkan: test the sprite ramp without integer division
- GS: drop a reference to private notes from the sprite ramp comment
- GS/Vulkan: carry the sprite ramp in its own vertex shader variant
- Tests: lift write protection before SetExtraMemory shrinks the map
- GS: a local move forgets the destination's alpha whatever its format
- GS: alpha rectangles only from sprites shown to write every pixel
- GS: keep one target copy for a run of draws on the copy road
- GameDB: raise Beyond Good & Evil to High blending on mobile
- GS/Vulkan: keep the sprite ramp off shuffles and filtered sprites
- GS/Vulkan: lower a texel-coordinate sprite's U/V past its first column on the console's ramp
- GS: list GSAlphaKnownRects.h in the MSVC project
- GS: exact alpha-mask drop reads alpha bits known inside rectangles
- GS: rules for alpha bits known inside rectangles of a target
- GS: test destination alpha in the shader when the mask keeps bit 7
- Report: the consent text says reports are kept 14 days, not 90
- Android: no Qualcomm driver notice at game start
- Translations: 2.9.4's new strings in all 19 languages
- iOS: show JIT Off in Settings while the interpreter runs
- iOS: run a stub from the code arena before using it
- iOS: ask Dopamine to mark the app debugged at launch
- iOS: pick the iOS 26 JIT mode from the device tree
- iOS: split ShaderWorkspaceView around ShaderWorkspaceModel
- iOS: split AppearanceSettingsView into three section views
- iOS: reach the About page from the Settings list
- iOS: split SettingsRootView into its pane, pages and JIT section
- iOS: move the BIOS library state and row out of BIOSListView
- iOS: split MenuAudioPackManager into install and event extensions
- iOS: split OrbitKeysModel into its types and an input extension
- iOS: correct the skin replace gate's comment and drop its deinit
- iOS: split the Virtual Pad settings page into a flow model and sections
- iOS: split RootView into one file per menu type and two modifiers
- iOS: keep every live view per card in the launch card registry
- iOS: read the library's landscape state from one container size
- iOS: export the legacy fallback for an unset orientation option
- iOS: sort by display name when a favorite toggles
- iOS: split GameListView into library models, cards and layouts
- iOS: keep the speed shortcut's live speed across a menu round trip
- iOS: keep the virtual pad toggle across a menu round trip
- iOS: drop AppState.selectedTab, which nothing reads
- iOS: split GameScreenView, with GameSession taking the game lifecycle
- iOS: split the Cheats panel into a session and three section views
- iOS: split the pause menu into its footer, panel and navigation graph
- iOS: split the per-game panel into a draft, session and coordinator
- MSVC: list the three headers the Visual Studio project was missing
- Android: say that save states do not load across the Extended RAM switch
- Tests: run and rewrite an EE JIT block above 64MB with Extended RAM
- Report: convert GPU clocks to kHz in the power snapshot
- Report: record live clocks, thermals and power state
- GameDB: Full clamping, not Exact, is what Stuntman and Driv3r need
- Android: a switch for Extended RAM (128MB)
- Memory: Extended RAM runs on the ARM64 EE recompiler outside arcade sessions too

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261114...1d1c26d8a2a7db715c674a2831176b13a256f868
